annotations.title: Read what each ad brought in

description: Reads, for each Click-to-WhatsApp ad, what its chats became in a period: chats started, how many were answered and handed to a person, the median time to the first answer, and their orders (written, confirmed, delivered, cancelled, returned) with the revenue of the orders paid or delivered, one amount per currency. With an ad account chosen for the number and a plan from Starter, also what each ad cost, the cost per delivered order and the return on ad spend; spend.status says why the cost is missing otherwise. Totals over every ad come with it. Owners and admins. Ad words come back marked untrusted. Read-only.
